recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Any future xhtml PrimitiveType/baseDefinition or primitive-list change should be handled under a resolved FHIR-57292 or equivalent FHIR-I decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I STU3 change request asking that xhtml be included on datatypes.html because Narrative.div used it like primitive datatypes and its StructureDefinition kind was primitive-type.
initial_application: The Jira comment's svn revision 14291 corresponds to git commit f80d9a7a03c02dc731793f576b9d4b25d6166528, which added xhtml to source/datatypes/specialtypes.diagram and updated the then-current SVG generator. The current source still includes xhtml in the active special-purpose datatype diagram used from datatypes.html.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-34314 refined xhtml treatment by adding an explicit XHTML Content section on narrative.html and keeping xhtml datatype references routed there; the combined branch already has a no-change reconciliation commit for FHIR-34314. New issue FHIR-57292 asks whether xhtml should derive from PrimitiveType or appear in the primitive list, but it is Submitted and unresolved.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope source already makes xhtml discoverable from datatypes.html, routes xhtml to narrative.html, and provides xhtml XML/JSON definition links and constraints there. Moving xhtml into the primitive table would preempt the unresolved FHIR-57292 question rather than reconcile this applied STU3 issue.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue added the xhtml StructureDefinition that FHIR-17446 cited as evidence that xhtml existed as a FHIR-defined type.
Later Published issue defined current xhtml presentation on narrative.html rather than changing the primitive table; it is already reconciled on the combined branch.
Submitted unresolved issue asks whether xhtml should derive from PrimitiveType or be included in the primitive list, so this audit does not preempt that decision.
